import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,base64,io
from PIL import Image
for tag,pdf,pages in [('setup','pagerank',[2,4,5,14]),('chain','pagerank',[19,20,24,25]),('thesis','ninove-thesis',[1,104,111,122])]:
 images=[]
 for page in pages:
  q=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-scale-to','1100','-singlefile','-png','inputs/'+pdf+'.pdf'],capture_output=True,check=True)
  images.append(Image.open(io.BytesIO(q.stdout)).convert('RGB'))
 canvas=Image.new('RGB',(max(i.width for i in images)*2,max(i.height for i in images)*2),'white')
 for k,i in enumerate(images):canvas.paste(i,((k%2)*(canvas.width//2),(k//2)*(canvas.height//2)))
 b=io.BytesIO();canvas.save(b,format='PNG')
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'renders/'+tag+'.png','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(b.getvalue()).decode(),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 print(tag,canvas.size)
